description: Defines API endpoints for managing product data in a FastAPI application, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products with appropriate security dependencies.

methods.name: list_products_endpoint(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), active_only: bool = Query(default=True, description="Only active products"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list products, optionally filtering by active status.

methods.name: get_product_endpoint(product_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific product by ID.

methods.name: create_product_endpoint(payload: ProductCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product (admin only).

methods.name: update_product_endpoint(product_id: int, payload: ProductUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing product (admin only).

methods.name: delete_product_endpoint(product_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a product (admin only).
